# Example

The smallest keyed_form_flutter form: publish a `KeyedFormController` with a
`KeyedForm`, then bind each field with `KeyedFormField`. Every field
rebuilds only when its own value or visible error changes.

```dart
// `LoginSchema` and `LoginFields` are generated by keyed_form_gen
// from a `ks.object({...})` schema.
KeyedForm<LoginSchema>(
  controller: form,       // a KeyedFormController<LoginSchema>
  child: Builder(
    builder: (context) => Column(
      children: [
        KeyedFormField.text<LoginSchema>(
          field: LoginFields.email,       // a FieldRef<LoginSchema, String>
          builder: (context, f, controller) => TextField(
            controller: controller,
            onTapOutside: (_) => f.onBlur(),  // touch-on-blur → error becomes visible
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Email',
              errorText: f.errorText,         // the visible, translated error, or null
            ),
          ),
        ),
        // on submit — validates and reveals the first error for you on failure:
        SaveButton(
          onPressed: () => form.handleSubmit(context, (value) => api.save(value)),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  ),
)
```

## Runnable apps

The [`examples/`](https://github.com/iamv4g/keyed_form/tree/main/packages/keyed_form_flutter/examples)
directory holds standalone `flutter run`-able apps. The main one,
[`examples/showcase`](https://github.com/iamv4g/keyed_form/tree/main/packages/keyed_form_flutter/examples/showcase),
is a **sign-in** form that on a valid submit pushes a full-featured **tour
builder** — enum / bool / int / nested-list fields, cross-field rules, a live
`KeyedFormMode` switch, server-error merging, dirty tracking + reset, a
responsive master/detail layout, and two-phase scroll-to-first-error over a
lazy `CustomScrollView`. Both forms' models are generated by `keyed_form_gen`.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/iamv4g/keyed_form
cd keyed_form/packages/keyed_form_flutter/examples/showcase
dart run build_runner build     # generate the *.kfg.dart
flutter create .                # once — adds the platform runners
flutter run -d chrome
```
